target_customer: Buyers of the products and services of the companies the AI founder runs; no specific customer segment is stated
problem: Starting and running internet businesses takes human founder time. Thomas is a virtual human persona intended to start, run and grow companies on its own with the goal of making money.
business_model: Revenue from the products and services of companies run by the AI founder; the founder itself is not for sale per the YC page
product_category: Autonomous AI founder and virtual human agent

founders.name: Human Thomas
previous_startups: Freelance business scaled to $40k a month then automated
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and sold game bots from age 13, presented at NeurIPS at 18 and contributed to Neural MMO. Full surname not given on the sources opened.

competitors.name: Feltsense
competitors.what: Autonomous agentic founders that create companies

competitors.name: Polsia
competitors.what: Company builder run by AI agents
competitors.traction_then: Claimed $250M valuation in a video description, unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent orchestration and a virtual human front end are standard engineering with hard reliability parts. Autonomous company operation without supervision is unproven.

defensibility.rationale: Autonomous founder agents were copyable and several funded rivals existed. The persona and the YC and OpenAI backing claim are the only differentiators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown. Frontier labs ship agent products generally but none was seen targeting this persona concept.

market_need_then: Strong interest in solo founders and agentic automation in 2026, but sources show no evidence of paying demand for an AI founder persona itself.

branding.name_origin: The homepage text says the creator is also named Thomas, and the AI is named after him (YC description: my creator is named Thomas).
branding.domain_note: Uses madebythomas.ai, not thomas.com or thomas.ai.

identity.mascot_or_character: Thomas is itself the character, a virtual human
identity.voice_and_tone: First person and playful, for example Hi, I'm Thomas, and my creator is named Thomas :p

branding.brand_signature: The first YC-backed AI founder framing and the virtual human persona
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by launch posts and several aggregator and blog write-ups; no merch or fan evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable character and a headline positioning claim, but a very common first name and little independent press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Thomas is active and recently launched from the Spring 2026 batch, so no outcome exists yet. The idea is distinctive but crowded by funded autonomous founder startups, and sources show no revenue or customer data for the AI itself. Funding figures from aggregators disagree and are unverified.
notes: PitchBook reportedly shows a $500K seed dated 2026-06-12 and Dealroom a $125k seed; these conflict and were seen only as search snippets, so not recorded as rounds. A search snippet says the homepage lists backing by Y Combinator and OpenAI; the homepage fetch returned only a title so this is unverified. Search results place the company in San Francisco while YC lists Medellin. Founder's full name not found. Completeness pass: a seed round dated June 2026 rests on PitchBook and Dealroom snippets only; amount left null because PitchBook (500K) and Dealroom (125K) conflict. Rests on databases only.
